entry: D67 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Jointly add two and three visible squares, five. Inspect supplied three-clap/one-clap four-dot record; imagine joining. Explicitly teach four with none joining stays four; four with one joining becomes five. No symbols. Day 81 will rehearse these ideas. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D68 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Teacher moves two of five squares off: three remain. Partition all five into two/three, preserving whole. Remove all five: none. Children correct supplied final states, never independently remove from a bean pile. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D69 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Apply day 68: Rin has five squares, puts two in tray, three remain. Complete adult-started one-and-three joining story, four. Children supply a missing action, not a complete silent-picture story. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D70 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Model retaining adult-told two-and-two square story, four. With picture cues predict a missing event or finish a partial retelling before jointly solving. One actor, one question at a time. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D71 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Explicit correspondence: Rin has seven squares, moves three, four remain. Name what a counter represents as adult narrates events separately; children follow or repair a partial action, never independently retell while moving. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D72 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Three and four squares, seven, or seven with three removed, four. Adult-directed counters; repair supplied partial drawing if preferred, never complete blank-paper story solution before E72. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D73 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Apply put-together total-unknown: Rin has three striped and three plain squares, six altogether. Complete supplied model referents. Review four take one, three remain, point to group asked about; no complete independent model-explanation practice. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D74 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Teach how visible whole, incoming marks and cross-outs tell action. Correct one supplied drawing at a time for two-and-two, four, and four-take-two, two. Compare stages serially, never candidate-choice sheets. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D75 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Apply drawings by adding a missing mark to supplied two-and-two, four-take-two and ten-take-five records: four, two, five. Retain original whole; no complete empty-scene story record. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D76 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Sort individual incoming/removed cues; finish supplied contrast sentences for two joined by three, five, and five losing two, three. No complete story-pair comparison before exit. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D77 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Apply using one-and-three or two-and-two squares, four. Complete missing question in adult-started object story; partner solves. Stay within practice set; no whole picture-prompt story creation. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D78 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Teach expression, plus +, minus -, equation, equals = using 2 + 3 = 5 and 5 = 2 + 3, then 5 - 2 = 3 and 3 = 5 - 2. Build both sides with squares and match one to one. Complete adult-started actions/signs, never select finished actions from expressions. Teach both orders before F1. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D79 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Model 3 + 3 = 6 and 6 = 3 + 3 beside a frame, then 6 - 3 = 3 and 3 = 6 - 3. Correct supplied groups/labels, build jointly. No reserved final cases or picture-to-many-equations matching. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D80 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Withdraw supplied frames, retain choice/access frames. Correct supplied models beside 4 + 4 = 8 or 8 - 4 = 4. Never start practice from a bare expression. All content was taught. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D81 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Correct puppet records for four plus zero, four, and four plus one, five; rehearse nine plus one, ten. Day 67 ideas, immediate model feedback; no new content or independent fresh cup explanation. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D82 supplied square model and correction
note: Invented for practice. Interpret adult-told four-and-four square stories, eight, and eight-take-four, four, beside both equation orders. Correct supplied relations; no new teaching or independent story-from-expression practice. Follow authored Shape reservations; never reuse a check case.

entry: D64 two-and-three then three-and-four square grouping
note: Invented for practice; guided hook/model, five then seven. Supplied movement paths, never independent blank-mat combining. Retrieval eight-frame/seven-scatter unscored.

entry: E64 reserved Four striped and two plain large paper corks beside an empty mat.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Both groups, six. Meets: six traces, "Six altogether." Shape: Independent loose-group combination on blank paper; practice follows supplied movement paths and repairs already-combined layouts, never independently combines on a blank mat or uses corks.

entry: E65 reserved Three fox pictures and six owl pictures, separate groups.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Nine, both groups. Meets: nine dots, "Nine." Shape: Whole across separate animal groups without intermediate totals; practice corrects supplied classroom-object totals on already-combined mats, never separated animal groups/blank total panels.

entry: E66 reserved One boot picture and seven scattered boot pictures, no route.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Eight, each picture once. Meets: eight matched ticks and count eight. Shape: Independently devise a route across scattered groups; practice follows adult-supplied routes and repairs a supplied missing tick, never invents a route or uses boots.

entry: E67 reserved Two quiet chime sounds, pause, then six; repeat identically if needed.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Eight units, both bursts. Meets: two disks joined by six, eight dots. Shape: Reconstruct heard bursts independently as action/paper trace; practice moves visible squares jointly or corrects supplied clap records, never reconstructs heard bursts. Quiet mouth sounds/visible beats or tactile taps replace a chime.

entry: E68 reserved Ten large paper bean pictures in a pile.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Ten first, three moved, seven remain. Meets: seven ringed, three outside. Shape: Independently remove a specified part from a fresh loose whole; practice corrects already-moved square layouts or follows directed partitions, never independent new-pile removal. Paper beans replace real beans.

entry: E69 reserved Silent toy-boat panels show five in play and Rin bringing two more.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Five first, two join, seven now. Meets: "Rin had five boats, brought two, seven now." Shape: Independently narrate/enact a silent joining scene with a partner; practice supplies a missing action in adult-started square stories, never creates complete stories from silent panels or uses boats.

Invented for practice; independent check only. Six first, two joining, whole-question, in order. Meets: "Six puppets, two more, how many now?" Eight is a later solution, not a second exit ask. Shape: Retell a complete unseen heard story before solving; practice predicts missing events with adult cues or finishes partial retellings, never retells an entire unseen story or uses puppets.

Invented for practice; independent check only. Nine first, six inside, three outside. Meets: three traced outside, faithful retelling. Shape: Independent retelling coordinated with object/location action; practice follows adult narration event by event or repairs partial cues, never independently retells while moving or uses trucks.

Invented for practice; independent check only. Ten represented, three removed, seven remaining. Meets: ten dots, three crossed, seven ringed. Shape: Generate a complete separating drawing independently on blank paper; practice uses adult-directed counters or supplied partial drawing corrections, never a whole blank-paper solution or puzzle pieces.

Invented for practice; independent check only. Seven first, one joins, eight; parts tied to question. Meets: seven outlined, one added, "All eight shells." Shape: Independently produce/explain a complete new model; practice corrects supplied referents or completes adult-started models, never independently produces/explains a whole shell model.

Invented for practice; independent check only. First picture: six first, two off, four remain. Meets: six-start/two-off positively marked. Selection alone does not establish method.

Invented for practice; independent check only. Ten initial marks, six changed, four remain. Meets: ten dots, six crossed, four ringed. Shape: Full independent change-record on empty scene; practice adds a missing mark to supplied square drawings, never produces a whole empty-scene record or uses blocks/shelf.

Invented for practice; independent check only. Both change by seven; join to ten, remove to three. Meets: "Seven come in here, seven go out there." Results support comparison, not extra asks. Shape: Independent comparison of opposite actions in two complete stories; practice sorts single action cues or finishes supplied contrast sentences, never compares a whole story pair or uses ribbons.

entry: E77 reserved Two closed-box pictures and eight open-box pictures.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Both groups, total-unknown question, ten if solved. Meets: "Rin has two closed boxes and eight open boxes. How many boxes altogether?" Shape: Create a whole total-unknown story from pictures; practice completes an adult-started object-story question, never creates a whole picture-prompt story or uses boxes. Unheard stories stay pending.

entry: E78 reserved Read card 2 + 5. Badge scenes: Rin brings five to two; takes five from seven; leaves two and keeps five unused.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Two first, five join, seven now. Meets: first scene and incoming group marked. Shape: Expression-to-action recognition with positive action evidence; practice builds/corrects an adult-started action then writes a sign, never selects finished actions from expressions or uses badges.

Invented for practice; independent check only. Nine total, seven/two parts, accepts total-left. Meets: correct mat, both groups marked. Shape: Spoken total-left equation to existing objects, all choices same total so counting/elimination alone is insufficient; practice jointly builds/corrects quantities beside equations, never selects complete object mats, seven/two partitions or fans.

entry: E80 reserved Bare card 10 - 2, blank paper and loose counters. Read

entry: E81 reserved Six cup pictures with empty arriving-group box.

One is rehearsed, not a second exit ask.

entry: E82 reserved Read bare expression 9 - 5 beside a blank scene.
